title: The 3 biggest tech layoffs of 2026 and what they mean for developers

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What do the 2026 tech layoffs reveal about the future of developer roles and AI integration in industry?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Generative AI and automation reduced demand for repetitive coding, but increased need for AI oversight and ethical engineering.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Layoffs highlight growing inequality — developers in low-skill areas face obsolescence, while AI literacy becomes a new class divide.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are shifting focus to AI alignment, security, and hybrid human-AI workflows that prioritize transparency and accountability.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where developers co-create with AI, shaping tools that enhance human potential rather than replace it.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The path ahead demands adaptability — redefining developer value through collaboration, ethics, and innovation.
